architecture_block: D SMC offline rule and sample preparation
objective: Deliver independently runnable daily-change, earnings-to-thesis, and SMC preparation trials with hash-bound citations, readable reports and explicitly pending human verification.
non_goals: No nightly dependency or production change.
No selection, paper registration, strategy parameters approval or model effectiveness claim.
No TradingView, network data acquisition, paid models, scheduled jobs or team access.
dependencies: Human-selected first two workflows and SMC preparation from 20260918 workflow drafts
input_contracts: Local frozen source bytes with sha256, company, source tier and time
Versioned trial request; source-bound prior claim inventory
Frozen OHLCV windows and unapproved SMC rule draft
output_artifacts: Machine receipts and human verification templates bound to report hashes
Source manifest and negative test/mutation evidence
Local historical pilot outputs, not committed raw source material
acceptance_tests: Reject changed bytes, invented excerpts, future/foreign-company citations, incomplete thesis coverage and false human approval.
Run every workflow without nightly or live APIs; unchanged inputs replay identical output hashes.
SMC remains an unapproved rule/sample preparation artifact; future bars are absent from each annotation window.
approval_gates: Human verification is pending, never synthesized.
Draft PR requires full offline CI; merging requires separate approval.
No production, scheduled task, model provider or trading authorization is implied.
